# `>=`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns true if `expr1` is greater than or equal to `expr2`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
expr1 >= expr2
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- >=, example 1
> SELECT 2 >= 1;
true
```

```sql
-- >=, example 2
> SELECT 2.0 >= '2.1';
false
```

```sql
-- >=, example 3
> SELECT to_date('2009-07-30 04:17:52') >= to_date('2009-07-30 04:17:52');
true
```

```sql
-- >=, example 4
> SELECT to_date('2009-07-30 04:17:52') >= to_date('2009-08-01 04:17:52');
false
```

```sql
-- >=, example 5
> SELECT 1 >= NULL;
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
